description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC controller model convention that groups controllers by API version derived from the route attribute.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A convention implementation to group API controllers based on their route attribute, specifically the first segment representing the API version.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Modifies the controller model to set its ApiExplorer.GroupName based on the route attribute's first segment representing the API version.
